belief.required: Every paired initialization and expected validation condition; complete matrix and minimum512 examples per cell
belief.calibration: Compare confidence with expected correctness under privileged joint posterior; support membership is a separate metric

return.required: Report short-delay acquisition before16step retention; every pairedseed and expectedvalidation condition; minimum512 percell

semantics.note: No scalinglaw or convergence claim from available corpus size alone; failed acquisition must be reported independently.

rule: Exact oracle/register correctness is architectural, not acquired neural competence. Small fixedset memorization and empty/incomplete results cannot pass.
